nom: CeraVe Hydrating Micellar Water & Makeup Remover for Face, Lips & Eyes

avis.titre: The Best Micellar for Sensitive Combination skin
avis.texte: Cerave changed their packaging so it threw me off when I was looking for the original Hydrating Micellar Water. This is the only micellar water that I've used for years. I tried the garnier, it was too soapy and abrasive for my sensitive skin. The sensibio one was better than garnier as far as irritation, but THIS one I cannot live without. I saw the review below that said it irritated their eyes, let's be frank if you have sensitivity to hylauronic acid maybe avoid this product. Also, I noticed that a mascara I switched too did cause my eyes to burn when removing it with this product. I switched back to my fenty mascara and maybelline and had no issues.
This works to get my stubborn smudge proof eye makeup and set on makeup off easily. I like that it is hydrating and doesn't leave my face feeling dry.
I was trying to find a micellar water with better ingredients since I dont rinse it off, but this stung my eyes so bad!!
